title: Baked Pumpkin Croatian Casserole
description: A delicious and easy-to-make casserole perfect for fall and winter seasons. Combining the flavors of Croatia with the warmth of pumpkin.
instructions: Cook the ziti pasta according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, ricotta cheese, eggs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the cooked ziti pasta.
Spread half of the pumpkin-ricotta mixture over the pasta.
Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
